calls.prompt: Full-body orthographic front view of Brennic, a broad, stocky, middle-aged fire mage of the Roman era: bare-headed with short dark curly hair, no hood, a full dark beard, a strong brow. He wears a plain knee-length wool tunic with short sleeves, belted at the waist with a wide leather belt; a heavy wool cloak draped over both shoulders like a shawl, fastened at the chest and hanging behind him to the back of the knees; leather wraps on both forearms; a plain iron prisoner's collar; wrapped shins and simple leather sandals. He stands in a neutral A-pose: arms straight, held out and angled about 35 degrees down away from the torso so they do not touch the body or the cloak, open empty hands with fingers together, legs slightly apart, feet flat. No weapon, no staff, no fire, no effects. He faces the camera directly, symmetrical, the whole figure from head to sandals visible with empty margin around it, centred on a plain flat light grey background, no scenery, no ground, a single character. Game-ready 3D character model reference for a modeller: simple large readable shapes, chunky proportions, big hands, matte surfaces, one flat colour per material with no pattern and no texture detail. Palette blocks: tunic muted brick red, cloak dark charcoal brown, belt, wraps and sandals mid brown leather, collar dark iron grey, skin warm tan, hair and beard dark brown. Soft even studio light, no cast shadows, no text, no labels, no grid, no watermark.
